Subject: Re: [opensuse] Computer does not turn off

Stephan Schöffel wrote:
> hi there,
> 
> i just installed 10.3 to an old athlon 1200. the problem is, that after 
> shutting down suse, the computer does not turn off.
> 
> The last line on the screen is:
> Master Resource Control: Runlevel 0 has been reached
> 
> and then freezes.
> 
> it sounds like the harddisk is powered off, but the motherboard is still 
> active and has to be switches off manually via powerbutton.
> 
> i already looked for options in bios but could not find any. any ideas?
> 
> --stephan
> 

This is a known PITA bug that for some reason has appeared in 10.3. See:
https://bugzilla.novell.com/show_bug.cgi?id=331747
They are up to Comment #120 or so. I have 3 machines this problem 
affects 5-8 others that have no problem. Go figure...
